annotations.title: Get found: approve or decline a recruiter

description: Approve or decline a recruiter's request to contact the user about one of their CVs. Approving shares the user's contact details with that recruiter — only on the user's explicit decision.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.
